spec_references: Statements: Destructuring assignment statement — Only supports wildcard-binding-pattern
reason: The negative diagnostics depend on error destructuring assignments with named detail targets and rest targets, plus nested tuple destructuring. Subset 10 explicitly limits destructuring assignments to wildcard-binding-pattern, so these essential patterns are outside scope even though error constructors are supported.
unsupported_constructs: Error destructuring assignments such as error(reason11, ...detail11) = err1 and error(reason12, message = message12, detail = detail12) = err1
Nested tuple destructuring assignment [intVar, stringVar, errorVar, [errorVar2, fooVar]] = t1
test_design_notes: The file asserts compile-time errors using @error markers; it has no @args, @panic, or @output assertions. Negative testing does not make unsupported destructuring patterns in scope.
